about_the_game:
Embark on a mythical journey into the underworld in Quetzal, a challenging 2D platformer with pixel art inspired by Mesoamerican mythology.
Step into the role of Quetzalcóatl, the legendary Feathered Serpent, on his perilous mission to recover the sacred bones of humanity. Face deadly obstacles and traps placed by the ruthless god of the underworld, Mictlantecuhtli, as you explore ancient temples, dark chambers, and danger-filled ancestral landscapes.
Quetzal combines precise gameplay, constant challenge, and an atmosphere steeped in pre-Hispanic mystery, delivering a retro experience that will test your reflexes and courage.

• High-precision 2D platforming: Jump, dodge, and run through levels designed to challenge even the most skilled players.
• Pixel art inspired by Mesoamerican iconography: A unique visual reinterpretation of deities, symbols, and underworld settings.
• Lethal obstacles and hidden traps: Overcome areas filled with spikes, pits, moving platforms, and deadly mechanisms.
• Dark and mythological atmosphere: Discover ancient temples and sacred chambers inhabited by supernatural forces.
• Based on ancient legends: Experience Quetzalcóatl’s epic journey as told in ancestral Mesoamerican traditions.
